messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — external pen-test scheduled Tue 2026-04-06 09:00 PT. We need a concise runbook for: RBAC temporary roles, KMS access proofs, audit log extraction, and retest criteria.

kevin: Thanks. Can you list the exact artifacts the assessors will need for KMS + audit?

maria: Assessor asks: (1) presigned S3 export of CloudTrail+App logs for the window, (2) read-only KMS decrypt demo creds + logs showing key usage, (3) mapping of IAM roles changed and why. Also ephemeral role start/end times.

leo: For RBAC changes: prefer ephemeral role via org-sso with timeboxed session. Suggested policy: allow: kms:Decrypt (on specific alias), logs:DescribeExportTasks, logs:GetLogEvents. Keep broad actions limited.

nina: @leo can you paste the minimal IAM policy snippet we can hand to assessors for review?

leo: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01"
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["logs:GetLogEvents","logs:DescribeLogStreams"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:logs:us-west-2:123456789012:log-group:/redwood/*"
    }
  ]
}
```

ash: For evidence packaging: we should produce a timeboxed export and a short README.md listing how to validate. Also include a signed hash of the export.

maria: Agreed. Add checks: (A) verify CloudTrail shows AssumeRole events for the ephemeral role, (B) KMS KeyUsage shows decrypt calls with assessor principal, (C) audit export checksum matches.

kevin: Who owns generating the export and presigned link? I can do it but will need an ops window.

nina: I can coordinate ops window with platform. Proposed window: Tue 08:30–10:30 PT. We do the role swap at 08:50, run tests at 09:00, export at 09:15.

maria: Perfect. Also need to prepare remediation tracking board. Suggest a small template: vuln id, severity, owner, ETA, remediation notes, evidence attached, retest window.

leo: Can we reuse the interim JIRA + label 'pen-test-temp' so we can snapshot easily?

ash: Yep. We'll create a sprint board filter: labels in (pen-test, remediation). Link PRs and docs.

kevin: One question about KMS: do assessors need plaintext decrypted secret or just logs showing decrypt? Some regs ask for data samples.

maria: We will not share plaintext secrets. Provide data-key generation logs and a demo decrypt of a sanitized sample string (random, no PII). Document the steps and hash.

pen-test-bot: Reminder: pre-engagement questionnaire due 48h before start. Link: https://vendor.example.com/pre-engagement.

nina: Action items extracted: 1) leo — prepare ephemeral role policy + assume-role timeline. 2) kevin — plan export presigned link and ops contact. 3) ash — create README + checksum step. 4) maria — build remediation board template and JIRA filter. 5) all — confirm by EOD Fri.

kevin: I'll take export and ops; will post the presigned link in this thread once ready.

leo: I'll drop the final IAM snippet and a short runbook for assume-role flow by EOD.

ash: I'll scaffold README and the hash script (sha256sum) and attach to the evidence bundle.

maria: Great. One more: retest criteria — we accept fixes gated by 'no regression in staging for 48h + evidence attached + re-audit signoff'. If high severity, retest within 72h preferred.

nina: I'll block the first retest slot Thu 09:00 PT and keep backup on Fri.

maria: Thanks everyone — please ack with :thumbsup: when you've added items to JIRA.

kevin: 👍 added export task to JIRA, assigning to ops-oncall.

leo: 👍 policy pushed to draft doc.

ash: 👍 README scaffold up in the shared drive.

maria: Closing loop — will run a short dry-run Monday 10:00 PT to validate the flow. Drop any gotchas here before then.

nina: Noted.
